C0538.title: Man Sentenced for Malicious Order Cancellations Causing Over 540,000 Yuan in Losses
C0538.summary: A man surnamed Wu was sentenced to eight months in prison for repeatedly placing bulk orders on a company's Pinduoduo store and immediately requesting refunds to exact personal revenge, causing service fee losses totaling over 540,000 yuan.

references.title: Malicious order cancellations worth 540,000 yuan out of spite, defendant sentenced for sabotaging production and operation
